methods.label: Pair addends to make 50
methods.explanation:
Pair the smallest addend with the largest, then continue inward. This makes five equal sums:
\[
\begin{aligned}
&(1+49)+(11+39)+(21+29)\\
&\quad +(31+19)+(41+9)\\
&=5\cdot50=250.
\end{aligned}
\]
Every original addend appears exactly once, so reordering and grouping preserve the sum. The value is \(250\), choice \(\mathrm{E}\).
methods.levelReason: Uses elementary addition, valid regrouping, and multiplication as repeated addition.
